::: {#exr-beech-refer-hat}
In-class discussion: The gradient field. In optimization, we are walking on a field of gradient flowers. Each flower has a small stamen that points in a particular compass direction. We can, however, only see the stamen of the flower at hand. At each step, we examine that flower, then walk in the direction indicated for a small distance. Examining the flower at our new position gives a new direction to walk in. We continue in this way, following an uphill path from flower to flower.
:::
 <!-- end of exr-beech-refer-hat -->
